page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a bare-metal GPU-accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing 128 vCPUs without hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 6.0 GB per core.

This server integrates four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM, with 24 GB allocated per GPU. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

The lack of local storage requires reliance on external network storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs compared to local NVMe drives. However, the dedicated core allocation and high-speed network baseline mitigate virtualization overhead. This hardware profile is suited for GPU-accelerated workloads such as machine learning inference, video rendering, and parallel data processing tasks that benefit from dedicated physical cores and multi-GPU configurations.

The instance is configured with 768.0 GB of system memory, translating to 6.0 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, providing a total of 96 GB of VRAM. For connectivity, the server features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. A key architectural tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, requiring external network-attached storage solutions. This configuration is optimized for workloads such as medium-scale AI inference, 3D rendering, and high-performance computing tasks that require dedicated CPU resources and multi-GPU acceleration.
